title: 盾尾刷與密封脂系統
titleEn: Shield-tail brushes and sealing grease systems
summary: 本課聚焦以盾尾間隙、密封介質與壓力證據診斷盾尾漏水路徑。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on diagnose tail-seal leakage through clearance, sealing medium and pressure evidence. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設3道獨立密封各失效機率0.01，同時失效為10⁻⁶；真實共因失效會使獨立假設失效。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設名義徑向間隙40 mm、偏心15 mm，兩側示意間隙25與55 mm；未含橢圓化。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 3 independent barriers each with failure probability 0.01; simultaneous failure is 10⁻⁶, but real common causes invalidate independence. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed nominal radial clearance 40 mm and eccentricity 15 mm, opposite clearances are 25 and 55 mm, excluding ovalization. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

steps.title: 多道刷列的阻水機制：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Multiple brush-row sealing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「多道刷列的阻水機制」如何影響盾尾刷與密封脂系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Multiple brush-row sealing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shield-tail brushes and sealing grease systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 盾尾刷列與密封介質共同填住移動盾殼和環片之間的間隙，刷毛本身不是完整防水膜。多道密封提供分段阻力，但共用供應失效或同一幾何缺陷可能同時破壞多列。 假設3道獨立密封各失效機率0.01，同時失效為10⁻⁶；真實共因失效會使獨立假設失效。 三道刷列若共用堵塞管線可同時失去密封介質，計算出的極低機率便毫無依據；只強調道數會掩蓋真正脆弱的共用節點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「多道刷列的阻水機制」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tail brushes and sealing medium fill the moving gap between shield and lining; brushes alone are not an impermeable membrane. Multiple rows add barriers, but shared supply failure or a common geometric defect can defeat them together. Assume 3 independent barriers each with failure probability 0.01; simultaneous failure is 10⁻⁶, but real common causes invalidate independence. Three rows sharing a blocked supply can lose sealing medium together, invalidating the tiny calculated probability. Emphasizing row count conceals the shared node that actually limits the system. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Multiple brush-row sealing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「多道密封即使共用失效供應，也能直接按獨立機率相乘。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Multiple seals sharing a failed supply still justify multiplying independent failure probabilities." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「多道刷列的阻水機制」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 多道刷列的阻水機制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Multiple brush-row sealing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「多道刷列的阻水機制」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Multiple brush-row sealing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設3道獨立密封各失效機率0.01，同時失效為10⁻⁶；真實共因失效會使獨立假設失效。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 3 independent barriers each with failure probability 0.01; simultaneous failure is 10⁻⁶, but real common causes invalidate independence. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以系統圖標示刷列、供應線、壓力感測與共用設備，檢查失效是否真正獨立；比對各區消耗及漏水位置，設備主管需審查共因情境，不把多道數量直接換成可靠度保證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map rows, supply lines, sensors and shared equipment and test whether failures are independent; compare zone consumption and leakage location, with equipment review of common causes rather than reliability guaranteed by barrier count.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

Procurement quantities alone can confuse material loss with effective sealing. steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Grouting and seal interaction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.

steps.instructionEn: Synchronize grout-port and seal-zone records with elevation, sensor location and setting time; investigate whether leakage or consumption changes coincide with specific grouting events, with joint grout and equipment review. steps.instruction: 可見漏水量受收集範圍、排水混流與壓差影響，不能把排水泵總量全歸盾尾。持續上升或混入細土比單次清水滴漏更需追查，量測應將來源和時間分開。 假設專用收集槽5 min增加30 L，平均漏量6 L/min=0.1 L/s；未分流總排水不適用。 排水槽混入洗滌水可製造假漏水趨勢，細土沉積又可能使流量看似下降但侵蝕仍在；只有水量而無來源與固體證據，不能判斷惡化是否停止。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「漏水量與趨勢判讀」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Rising flow or fines warrants distinct investigation, with sources and time explicitly separated. An assumed dedicated tank gaining 30 L in 5 min indicates 6 L/min=0.1 L/s; mixed drainage cannot support the same attribution. Wash water creates false leakage trends, while deposited fines can reduce collected flow despite continuing erosion. Flow alone without source and solids evidence cannot establish that deterioration has stopped. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Leakage rate and trend interpretation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
